description: This file defines the AdminPageRouteModelProvider class, which implements IPageRouteModelProvider to modify route models for admin pages in an ASP.NET Core application, specifically identifying Razor pages with Admin attributes and adjusting route properties accordingly.

classes.name: AdminPageRouteModelProvider
classes.description: A provider that modifies page route models to identify admin Razor pages and mark them accordingly.

methods.name: OnProvidersExecuting
methods.description: Modifies route models based on whether the page is an admin page with an Admin attribute.

methods.name: OnProvidersExecuted
methods.description: Empty method, part of interface implementation.

methods.name: GetPageDescriptors
methods.description: Retrieves Razor page descriptors for a specific feature type, filtering out duplicates.

methods.name: IsRazorPage
methods.description: Checks if a view descriptor corresponds to a Razor page.

methods.name: GetViewFeature
methods.description: Creates and populates a ViewsFeature instance from the application part manager.
